note: The bands the wing plant has to land in, from docs/WING-STAGE1.md, which derives each from published figures for a 1000 mm flying wing. Never widened to pass; argue in the derivation instead.

w1_level_65.source: level speed at 65 percent throttle, derived 18.53, re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 6 x 4E curve (prop curves, scripts/wing-derive.js), was 15.2 on the straight line; the band keeps its 11.2 percent under and 15.1 percent over, the room for the estimated inputs (was 13.5 to 17.5) Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the gates' 4.1 V seat (w36-seat-voltage: the pack's loaded voltage over the table's v_meas through the motor's law, scripts/lib/propcurve.js wingSeat), and with the stick put through the electric motor's own law, n^2 + 5.667 n = 6.667 d (plant_wing.c prop_spool), where the derivation had flown it as the prop's speed share: derived 22.88, was 18.53; the same 0.888 to 1.151 of it.

w4_top.source: level speed at full throttle, derived 28.74, re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 6 x 4E curve (prop curves, scripts/wing-derive.js), was 23.8 on the straight line; the band keeps its 7.6 percent under and 13.4 percent over (was 22 to 27) Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the gates' 4.1 V seat (w36-seat-voltage: the pack's loaded voltage over the table's v_meas through the motor's law, scripts/lib/propcurve.js wingSeat): derived 32.17, was 28.74; the same 0.924 to 1.134 of it.

w5_roll.source: full elevon at about 20 m/s, derived 250 Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the gates' 4.1 V seat (w36-seat-voltage, scripts/lib/propcurve.js wingSeat): the gate rolls at the 65 percent stick, so at that stick's level speed, which the derivation now puts at 22.88 m/s (18.53 before, the 20 above a round figure for it); pb/2V is the airframe's, so the rate goes with the speed, 250 x 22.88 / 20 = 286; the same 0.720 to 1.200 of it.

w6_turn.source: radius against V^2 / (g tan bank) at the bank and speed flown

w7_climb.source: full throttle, best over a sweep of airspeeds, derived 17.92 at 16.2 m/s, re-derived 2026-10-11 on APC's 6 x 4E curve (prop curves, scripts/wing-derive.js), was 11.5 at 12.5 on the straight line; the band keeps its 30.4 percent under and 13.0 percent over (was 8 to 13) Re-derived 2026-10-12 on the gates' 4.1 V seat (w36-seat-voltage: the pack's loaded voltage over the table's v_meas through the motor's law, scripts/lib/propcurve.js wingSeat): derived 22.87 at 17.89 m/s, was 17.92 at 16.19; the same 0.696 to 1.131 of it.

w8_throw.source: a throw at 10 m/s, 60 percent, an eighth of up for two seconds; airborne and flying after three

w9_chop.source: throttle off from cruise, pitch stick neutral: a glide, not a tumble

w10_quad_hash.source: verify check 2's canonical replay hash of the five inch before the wing existed; the wing must not move it

w11_cross_host.source: the scripted flight's state trace hash, Node against headless Chrome

stab_straight.source: thrown level at 10 m/s, 3 m up, 0.65 throttle, every stick centred in Stabilised: the cross track after 10 s, left positive as the plant's y. Derived (npm run stab:straight, scripts/lib/throwflight.js): the CAP's throw (cap580:derive throwFlight) for this table, the body's six rates at the plant's step on the table's own coefficients, the motor spooled from the throw on its own law and its torque on the mount, right thrust where the table has it, the P factor, the jet normal force, the prop's gyroscope, the slipstream's terms with the swirl's force on the whole stream (scripts/lib/wash.js finSwirl, Deters, Ananda and Selig 2015, AIAA 2015-2265, fig. 22b), and Stabilised's loops with ArduPilot's roll integrator: derived 8.27 m. Against the plant (w36-physics): the cross track within 0.018 m along the curve at 0.5, 1, 2, 3, 5, 10 s (plant 8.25 m), the bank within 0.005 deg and the heading within 0.003 deg; with the drive's torque off the mount (sim_wing_set_mount(0)) within 0.000 m of the derived -0.31. Held within 0.05 m either way: the worst agreement of the two and the same again for what the model leaves out (the pack's drain, the ground's effect), and the derived figure's rounding, 0.01 m. Was: under 15 m off the line, a figure with no source. The airspeed at 10 s by the same rule: derived 22.28 m/s, the plant 22.24, within 0.039 along the curve, held within 0.09.

stab_straight_acro.source: thrown level at 10 m/s, 3 m up, 0.65 throttle, every stick centred in Acro (plant_wing.c acro_sticks: the attitude held where it was thrown): the cross track after 10 s, left positive as the plant's y. Derived (npm run stab:straight, scripts/lib/throwflight.js): the CAP's throw (cap580:derive throwFlight) for this table, the body's six rates at the plant's step on the table's own coefficients, the motor spooled from the throw on its own law and its torque on the mount, right thrust where the table has it, the P factor, the jet normal force, the prop's gyroscope, the slipstream's terms with the swirl's force on the whole stream (scripts/lib/wash.js finSwirl, Deters, Ananda and Selig 2015, AIAA 2015-2265, fig. 22b), and Acro's attitude hold: derived 0.01 m. Against the plant (w36-physics): the cross track within 0.000 m along the curve at 0.5, 1, 2, 3, 5, 10 s (plant 0.01 m), the bank within 0.001 deg and the heading within 0.000 deg; with the drive's torque off the mount (sim_wing_set_mount(0)) within 0.000 m of the derived -0.02. Held within 0.02 m either way: the worst agreement of the two and the same again for what the model leaves out (the pack's drain, the ground's effect), and the derived figure's rounding, 0.01 m. Was: under 15 m off the line, a figure with no source. The airspeed at 10 s by the same rule: derived 23.11 m/s, the plant 23.07, within 0.036 along the curve, held within 0.09.
